author: Julia Byrd
text: I’ve gotten this message on my last 2 sensors. First one lasted about 18 hours and the second one lasted less than 2 hours.  I waited about 15 hours before removing the first one and it never restarted.  I didn’t have a replacement for the second one and pharmacy wouldn’t refill my Rx stating it was too soon so I left the sensor in for 3 full days and it never restarted.  I got no response from my online request for replacements so it will be finger sticks for the remainder of the month for me
